Step 9 of the human IT ticketing workflow: verify the customer's reply and decide whether to close, reopen, or close-unresolved.

## Layout

```text
skills/verify-feedback-close-or-reopen/
├── SKILL.md
├── README.qmd
├── install.sh
└── scripts/
    └── verify_feedback.py
```

## Install

```bash
bash skills/verify-feedback-close-or-reopen/install.sh
```

## Usage through Claude

> "Customer replied: 'Tried it, still broken.' What now?"

Claude reads `SKILL.md`, runs the script with `--feedback-text`, and reports the next action.

## Direct CLI

```bash
uv run python skills/verify-feedback-close-or-reopen/scripts/verify_feedback.py \
    --ticket-id TKT-00042 \
    --feedback-text "Thanks, that fixed it!"
```

The script appends one row to `data/working/feedback_decisions.csv`.

## Public functions

- `classify_feedback(feedback_text)` — sentiment classifier; raises `ValueError` on empty input.
- `load_feedback_context(data_dir, out_dir, ticket_id, feedback_text)` — loads ticket, latest draft, and prior feedback row (for the reopen guard).
- `decide_next_action(context, classification)` — returns the policy decision (close / reopen / close-unresolved / request-clarification).
- `build_feedback_decision(context, it_member_id)` — full row for `feedback_decisions.csv`.
- `write_feedback_decision(out_dir, decision)`.
- `main(argv)` — CLI. Exits 2 on missing ticket / empty feedback / missing data, 3 on missing upstream draft.

## Reopen guard

The skill enforces "one reopen per ticket". Negative feedback with no prior reopen sets `next_action=reopen_and_escalate`. Negative feedback when the prior `feedback_decisions.csv` row already had `reopened_flag=true` sets `next_action=close_unresolved_vendor_followup` instead. This matches the workflow in `customer-ticket-process.pdf` and prevents infinite loops.

## Sentiment heuristics

`classify_feedback` matches phrases case-insensitively. Negative phrases beat positive ones when both occur and the negative phrase contains a strong marker like `still`, `not`, `didn't`, or `doesn't`. Ambiguous replies trigger `next_action=request_clarification`.

## Test

```bash
uv run pytest tests/skills/test_verify_feedback.py -v
```
